summary: McLaren's internal championship battle intensifies as Norris and Piastri collide over team strategy at Monza, where McLaren's recent pace surge threatens to upset the established order. Mercedes and Ferrari battle for track position at a circuit historically favoring high-downforce machines, while pit-stop execution and tire management become critical differentiators in a tactical chess match. A strong result here could reshape the championship picture and hand either McLaren driver a decisive advantage in the fight for the drivers' title heading into the final stretch.
